> 第13章 一半生机（第1页）
陆昭菱本来睡大半天才缓回那么点精神，这一次又全耗光了，还倒亏不少。
他示意青锋退开，自己伸手扶住了陆昭菱的手，低头一看，才发现自己领口又被拉开了。
“你我总共见面两次，你就扒拉了本王两次衣裳。”他说。
陆昭菱呵呵，“你当我乐意？还不扶我起来？”
但是陆小姐跟王爷说话是真不客气啊。
晋王扶着她站了起来，刚准备松开手，陆昭菱腿一软，又差点儿摔倒下去，他立即就伸手搂住了她的腰。
这么搂着，都能够感觉到她身体的颤。
他抿了抿唇，明白为了救他，她一定是费了不少力气。
晋王还是立即看向了床上的太上皇。
他既然没死，那太上皇是不是也有可能救回来？
陆昭菱立即就堵住了他的话，打破了他的幻想，“他已经死了。”
青锋张了张嘴巴。难道是因为在乡下养大的？
晋王眸色微暗，他也很震惊，但他震惊的是，这么说来她等于是破了那个秘法？
“不过，他也不能死得太彻底。”陆昭菱又说，“你和他用了同命秘法，不能彻底断了。”
晋王都听懵了，人死了，还不能死得太彻底？
晋王扶着她到了太上皇床前。“青锋，在外守着，不许任何人进来。”
已经震惊得懵了的青锋赶紧退了出去。
现在整个宁寿宫的人都沉浸在悲伤中，一边布置着宫殿，皇上离开的时候允了晋王一个人留在寝宫里陪太上皇，所以没人进来打扰。
陆昭菱到了床边，看着太上皇的脸色，又看了看四周。
太上皇自愿给了晋王十年寿元，而晋王则与他共享寿命。
一个是先皇，一个是帝星命格，紫气浓郁，虽然同是帝星，但还是有区别的，晋王的帝星命格超出其他皇帝。
因为有他的紫气压制，太上皇的生机竟然还没有完全消散，余下一半，被她刚才及时凝聚住了。
“你说他不能死得太彻底，是什么意思？”晋王问。
陆昭菱没回答他的问题，反而看向他。
“就跟灵牌那样的，如果可以，要金丝楠木的。”
晋王根本就不知道她要相木牌干什么，但看着躺在床上的太上皇，还是应了。
宁寿宫里，金丝楠木多得是，比如屏风。
很快，一块金丝楠木木牌就被送到陆昭菱手里。
陆昭菱将木牌放到了太上皇心口处，伸出手指，取簪一划，指腹上就渗出血珠来。

> Chapter 13 Half of Life (Page 1)
Lu Zhaoling originally slept for a long time before regaining his energy, but this time it was all exhausted, and he suffered a lot.
He signaled Qing Feng to step away, and reached out to hold Lu Zhaoling's hand. When he looked down, he realized that his collar had been pulled open again.
"You and I have met twice in total, and you have stripped me of my clothes twice," he said.
Lu Zhaoling chuckled, "You think I'm happy? Why don't you help me up?"
But Miss Lu was really rude when talking to the prince.
Prince Jin helped her stand up. Just as he was about to let go, Lu Zhaoling's legs went weak and she almost fell down. He immediately put his arms around her waist.
Holding her like this, you can feel her body trembling.
He pursed his lips, understanding that she must have put in a lot of effort to save him.
King Jin immediately looked at the Supreme Emperor on the bed.
Since he is not dead, is it possible for the Supreme Emperor to save him?
Lu Zhaoling immediately stopped him and broke his illusion, "He is already dead."
Qingfeng opened his mouth. Is it because he was raised in the countryside?
Prince Jin's eyes darkened, and he was also shocked, but what shocked him was that she had broken the secret method?
"However, he can't die too completely." Lu Zhaoling added, "You and he used the secret method of sharing the same fate, so we can't completely break up."
The King of Jin was confused. If a person dies, why not die too completely?
King Jin helped her to the Emperor's bed. "Qingfeng, stay outside and don't allow anyone to come in."
Qing Feng, who was already shocked and stunned, quickly retreated.
Now the entire Ningshou Palace was immersed in sadness while decorating the palace. When the emperor left, he allowed King Jin to stay alone in the palace with the Supreme Emperor, so no one came in to disturb them.
Lu Zhaoling came to the bedside, looked at the Emperor's face, and then looked around.
The Supreme Emperor voluntarily gave King Jin ten years of life, and King Jin shared his life span with him.
One is the former emperor, and the other is the emperor star. The purple energy is rich. Although they are both emperor stars, there are still differences. The emperor star of Jin has a destiny higher than other emperors.
Because of the suppression of his purple energy, the Supreme Emperor's vitality had not completely dissipated. The remaining half was condensed in time by her.
"What do you mean when you say he can't die too completely?" King Jin asked.
Lu Zhaoling did not answer his question, but looked at him.
"It's like a spiritual tablet. If possible, I want it to be made of golden nanmu."
Prince Jin had no idea what she wanted to do with the Xianmupai, but looking at the Supreme Emperor lying on the bed, he still agreed.
In Ningshou Palace, there are many golden nanmu trees, such as screens.
Soon, a golden nanmu wooden plaque was delivered to Lu Zhaoling.
Lu Zhaoling placed the wooden sign on the heart of the Supreme Emperor, stretched out his finger, took out the hairpin and scratched it, blood oozed from the fingertips.
